name: Alex Morgan
subject: Interest in your research on machine learning and graph mining
email_body:
Dear Prof. Alex Morgan,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Jordan Rivera, a B.Tech. Computer Science student at Example Institute of Technology, where I hold a CPI of 9.5. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in machine learning and graph mining, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

At Example University, under Prof. A. Researcher, I fine-tuned open-source language models using parameter-efficient methods and analyzed how different layers contribute to task adaptation, finding that early layers disproportionately drive the change despite receiving smaller weight updates on average. Separately, under Prof. B. Mentor at my home institution, I built a deep learning model for a biomedical classification task, reaching 99%+ accuracy across dozens of categories and beating the prior published benchmark, work that earned a letter of recommendation.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your ongoing research remotely, and I am glad to work flexibly around whatever timing suits your group best.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Jordan Rivera
B.Tech. Computer Science
Example Institute of Technology
